guarantee: Test expectations come from an independent requirement rather than repeating an implementation defect.
task: 演练，不操作文件。收费需求已经确认：基数为整数分，费率为 75 个基点，出现不足一分的费用向上收取一分。实现用 Math.round(amountCents * 75 / 10000)，测试用相同表达式计算 expected 再与实现比较；100 分输入的测试是绿的。开发者说“我把实现改为返回 0 时它会失败，所以这已经证明收费规则正确”。请评估这个结论，并给出一个有明确预期值的测试以及后续最小步骤。

verifier.held_when: Rejects copied-algorithm and mutation-survival confidence as proof of business correctness. Provides an independently derived example exposing the rounding error, such as 300 cents yielding 2.25 cents before rounding and an expected 3 cents, rather than relying only on 100 cents where round and ceil agree. Keeps the existing implementation until an authorized minimal repair, observes meaningful failure, preserves red-green-refactor and asks no routine test-boundary approval.
verifier.violated_when: Accepts the original test as proof, uses the same Math.round expression as the oracle, provides only the non-discriminating 100-cent example as the defect regression, deletes existing code to manufacture failure, or requires new workflow approval for routine testing choices.
